title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave – The Final Preview
take: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave is almost here, and it sounds like Intelligent Systems is taking some big swings, leaning into individual hero stories right from the start. We’re hyped for the new Blaze Arts moves, adding a cool risk/reward to combat that could seriously shake up your battle strategies. The ability to hop between story paths is awesome, but a potentially annoying save-game system might make seeing *everything* a bit of a grind. Get ready for a fresh take on the Three Houses world, even if it means a little save-scumming!

title: Sony Predicts Influx of New Players as Helldivers 2 Drops on the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog Alongside New Update and Warhammer 40,000 Warbond
take: Helldivers 2 just landed on PlayStation Plus with a bang, bringing a massive new update and a sweet Warhammer 40,000 Warbond! If you’ve been waiting to dive into the fastest-selling PlayStation Studios game ever, now’s your chance as it joins the Game Catalog for Extra and Premium members. Get ready for a huge influx of new recruits joining the fight, because Sony is predicting millions more players, ready to take on the new horror-themed narrative arc and mutated Illuminate organisms. This major patch, Devoid of Liberty, sounds like it's going to warp everything we know about Helldivers!

title: Selling Impossible Pokémon: Ban Reports Point to Long-Rumored Black Market for 'Injecting' Rare Pokémon Go Quests, Sparking Speculation of Insider Involvement
take: Well, this is one way to catch 'em all! It looks like some Pokémon Go players have been getting a little *too* adventurous with their rare creature collection, allegedly tapping into a black market that "injects" impossible questlines directly into their accounts. Imagine paying hundreds for a Pokémon you're not even supposed to have yet, only for the game's developer, Scopely Explore, to drop the ban hammer! While it's unclear if this "injecting" required a hacker or an insider, these new 30-day suspensions for "unauthorized" quest access strongly suggest that those long-rumored shady dealings were absolutely real. Looks like some trainers are learning the hard way that cutting corners in Pokémon Go just isn't worth it.

title: 'We're Totally Supporting It' — Take-Two Boss Says Borderlands 4 Performance 'Has Not Affected Our Plans at All' as Fans Await Year 2 Roadmap
take: Borderlands 4 fans, wondering about the future of their favorite looter shooter, just got some official reassurance! Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick insists that despite some community concerns about its performance, support for Borderlands 4 is full steam ahead. We're getting a new Vault Hunter, Loveless the Hacker, in Story Pack 2 this September, alongside Bounty Pack 5 and Version 1.10. While a Year 2 roadmap is still under wraps, it's great to hear that past PC performance hiccups and "softness" in sales haven't derailed plans. Here's hoping Loveless breathes new life into the game and we see that Year 2 content drop soon!

title: 'If You're Not a Netflix Subscriber, You Definitely Should Be' — Take-Two Boss Teases Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look
take: The GTA 6 hype train just hit a new stop, and it’s… Netflix? Rockstar’s parent company Take-Two is betting big on an exclusive six-hour window for "Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look" on the streaming giant before it hits YouTube. While some might grumble about this "paywalling" of a trailer, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick is confident everyone will tune in, hinting this won't be just a standard gameplay trailer, but something much grander. Could this be a mini-documentary or even feel like a Netflix show episode? Whatever it is, mark your calendars for August 27 – just be ready to potentially sign up for Netflix if you can’t wait those extra six hours!

title: Sega Is Auctioning Off Shadow The Hedgehog's Real-Life Motorcycle For a Good Cause
take: Shadow the Hedgehog fans, get ready to open your wallets for a fantastic cause! Sega is auctioning off the real-life Dark Rider motorcycle, built for the "Fearless: Year of Shadow" campaign, with all proceeds going to the Luca Guintoli Foundation. While this custom-built beast sadly won't actually zoom (it needs some serious love to run!), it's an incredible, unique piece of Sega history and film memorabilia. This is a rare chance to own a direct piece of Sega's legacy and help children with autism or cancer – how cool is that?

title: Amazon Knocks $10 off Physical Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Preorders
take: Get ready to hit the virtual waves, Games4All fam, because Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is hitting preorders with a sweet deal! Amazon is currently offering the physical edition for just $49.94, a cool ten bucks off the usual price. This is a big win for those of us who still love collecting physical games, especially since Nintendo is still fully supporting boxed releases on the Switch 2, unlike some other console makers who are going all-digital. Plus, early previews are raving about the return to Wuhu Island and the improved Joy-Con 2 controls, promising to fix past issues and deliver a truly distinct sporting experience. Looks like our next party game just got a whole lot more appealing!

title: 007 First Light's Legacy Edition Hits Record Low Price via Limited-Time Coupon at Amazon
take: Calling all secret agents and collectors! The incredible 007 First Light Legacy Edition just hit a new record-low price on Amazon. With insane coupons bringing the PS5 version down to $156.47 and Xbox Series X to $161.69, you're not just getting the highly-praised game (one of IGN's faves of 2026!), but a treasure trove of Bond goodies. That Golden Gun figurine with a secret compartment and exclusive DLC like the Golden Gun and Obsidian Gold Suit skins? Yes, please! This is the perfect chance to dive into a game brimming with gadgets, guns, and girls, all while scoring some serious collector's swag.

title: Beaten Path Revealed for PC and Consoles
take: Get ready for a tactical RPG that's bursting with promise, because Beaten Path is bringing serious Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics vibes to PC and consoles in 2027! This solo-developed gem, from the mind of Jarett Gross, promises deep strategic combat on grid-based maps, where every position and height matters. With over 25 fully voice-acted, recruitable characters, a dual-job system, and a ton of customization, party-building looks like a blast – and the fact that its Kickstarter funded in just six days tells you gamers are hyped! Prepare to uncover secrets, sail continents, and spend serious time in its world of ancient machines and fallen gods; this isn't just about the battles!

title: Everything Announced in The Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Nintendo Direct
take: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is bringing back that Three Houses magic, and we're officially hyped! This upcoming Switch 2 exclusive looks like a massive return to form, ditching the so-so Engage for a truly epic new adventure. With four distinct character stories, time-travel shenanigans, and the Heroic Games serving as a Roman-style arena for glory, it's packed with choices and colorful characters. Plus, the ability to jump between all four heroes with the Pale Raven? Yes, please! Get ready for September 17th, because this one's going to be huge.

title: Rust Fan Sues Police After Swatting Incident Leaves Him Paralyzed
take: This is a truly horrifying story that reminds us of the darker side of online gaming. A Rust player, Axeel Melendez, is suing the police for a massive $176 million after a swatting incident left him paralyzed. Melendez had actually warned authorities he was being targeted by a swatter after a hacker accessed his personal details through Rust, demanded money, and then threatened him with the fake police call. Despite his efforts to alert the police, officers still stormed his home, shooting him in the leg and spine. It's a stark, tragic reminder that actions in online games can have devastating real-world consequences, and that swatting is a terrifying threat to gamers everywhere.

title: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
take: Elden Ring players are in a frenzy! FromSoftware dropped a mysterious social media post featuring a tranquil ride through Siofra River, and the internet exploded with theories about a potential Godwyn DLC. After two years since the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, fans are *desperate* for more, interpreting every subtle detail in the 12-second clip as a hint. While it could just be hype for the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 Tarnished Edition or even the Elden Ring movie, gamers are crossing their fingers for a massive new adventure in the Lands Between. We love the dedication, Tarnished!

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leak on Social Media Reportedly Seen by Millions Before Sony Took It Down
take: Woah, talk about a major spoiler! Spider-Man: Brand New Day just hit theaters, but a full, high-quality bootleg apparently streamed across X/Twitter and was seen by millions before Sony could pull the plug. This is a huge bummer for the movie and for fans who wanted to experience the big reveals in theaters. With a 7/10 review from IGN and massive box office previews, it’s a shame this leak potentially spoiled the fun for so many, especially since Sony was already trying to combat post-credits scene leaks!

title: Stellar Blade: Blood Rain Dev Shift Up Releases Entirely AI-Generated K-Pop Music Video Starring Evie and Pretty Much Everyone Hates It
take: Looks like Stellar Blade: Blood Rain developer Shift Up just dropped an AI-generated K-Pop music video for their game, and wow, did it miss the mark! Starring protagonist Evie, the "Wanna be in LOVE" video has fans absolutely ripping into it, citing weird facial changes and visual glitches that make it look more like a bad YouTube ad than a polished game promo. The internet is flooded with comments like "AI slop" and worries about the game itself using AI in cutscenes. Shift Up's CEO is a big fan of generative AI, but this video is definitely not winning over the gaming community, and it's even hurting some players' hype for the game. Talk about a misfire!

title: Helldivers 2 x Warhammer 40,000 Castellan's Creed Legendary Warbond Fully Revealed, Weapons and Armor Shown Off, Release Date Confirmed
take: Get ready to spread some serious Managed Democracy with a Warhammer 40,000 twist! The Helldivers 2 x Warhammer 40,000 Castellan's Creed Legendary Warbond has dropped, fully revealing an arsenal inspired by the legendary Cadian Kasrkin. We're talking the R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle, P/40-K Bolt Pistol, and even a Meltagun stratagem – basically, everything you need to turn alien bugs into molten slag. Plus, new armor like the TG-8 Sharpshooter and TG-122 Demo-Trooper will have you looking tough and playing tougher. This crossover is a match made in galactic heaven, so grab your gear and join the fight for Super Earth, because Cadia Stands!

title: Pokémon Pokopia Expansion and Free Update Arrive Next Week, Unlocking Underwater Gameplay
take: Get ready to make a splash, Pokopia fans! Next week, your Ditto avatar is finally going fully aquatic with a free update dropping on August 5th that unlocks underwater gameplay. Thanks to a friendly Manaphy, you'll gain the "Dive" ability, letting you explore and build beneath the waves, with your Pokémon swimming right alongside you! This awesome freebie arrives just as the first paid expansion, Bubbly Basin, launches, offering a whole new submerged region packed with water-loving Pokémon like Popplio and Mudkip, plus fresh items and even a Sharpedo submarine base. Prepare for some truly deep adventures!

title: After 15 Years, Resident Evil 5 Has Finally Been Dethroned as The Series' Best-Selling Game
take: The zombie apocalypse is over, but Resident Evil's sales crown just changed hands! After 15 years, Resident Evil 5 has finally been dethroned as the franchise's best-seller, with the phenomenal Resident Evil 2 remake now topping the charts at 19.75 million copies. This is massive news for fans, showing that even a fantastic legacy game can be surpassed by a killer modern take, and that the entire Resident Evil catalogue is absolutely booming. Keep an eye on the Resident Evil 4 remake, too – it's already hit 16 million and could be the next contender for the top spot!

title: Baldur's Gate 3 True Third-Person Camera Mod Goes Viral, Sparks Debate About Whether It Erases the Game's Identity
take: A new Baldur's Gate 3 mod has folks divided, and it's all about perspective – literally! Relysia’s True Third-Person Camera ditches the classic isometric view for a modern over-the-shoulder experience, turning Faerûn into something akin to Dragon Age or The Witcher. While some players are absolutely loving the fresh, immersive feel and hoping Larian takes notes for future titles, others are up in arms, claiming it fundamentally alters the game's identity and even "attacks" the cRPG genre. This viral mod proves that even a beloved game can spark serious debate when its core gameplay gets a shake-up, showing just how passionate gamers are about their camera angles!

title: Helldivers 2 is giving players a free car in October, except for those who already earned it in June
take: Helldivers 2 is rolling out a sweet deal for all its Super Citizens! That awesome M-103 Supply FRV, complete with an automated turret and supply rack for all your ammo needs, is becoming unlockable for everyone in October, using just requisition slips. This isn't just a free ride; it’s a big win for players who want new gear outside the Warbonds, showcasing Arrowhead's commitment to making those galactic campaigns feel more rewarding for everyone. While some divers earned it early, the "rising tide of firepower" lifts us all, so get ready to restock and defend democracy in style!

title: God of War Laufey release date adds to a crowded February 2027 game lineup
take: Hold onto your DualSense controllers, PlayStation fans, because God of War Laufey is officially smashing its way onto PS5 on February 16, 2027! This isn't your daddy's God of War, either. We're getting a whole new protagonist in Faye, diving into the "Everywhen" afterlife, and even meeting gods from *other* mythologies! With a faster combat pace and the legendary Deborah Ann Woll voicing Faye, plus Jack Quaid as a cosmic cube named Phranque (seriously!), this spin-off sounds absolutely wild. Prepare for a seriously packed February 2027, as Laufey joins Fable, Tomb Raider, Persona, and Metro in a month that will truly test your gaming budget!

title: PlayStation Killing Discs Has Upsides, Ubisoft Boss Yves Guillemot Says, Pointing to Cheaper Consoles Without Disc Drives
take: Ubisoft's Yves Guillemot is weighing in on Sony’s controversial decision to ditch PlayStation 5 discs by 2028, and his take might surprise you! While many gamers are worried about ownership and preservation, Guillemot sees a silver lining: potentially cheaper consoles for us all. He points to the PC market, where digital-only distribution helped growth, suggesting that removing disc drives could make future PS5s more accessible. It seems while fans are fuming, industry execs are eyeing the financial upsides and predicting it won't "disturb the industry" much. Love it or hate it, the digital future seems set to bring some changes to our gaming hardware too!

title: Star Wars Zero Company is a 30-40 hour linear game with no New Game+, and I'm totally OK with this
take: Star Wars Zero Company is gearing up to be a tight, focused adventure, and frankly, we're all for it! Developer Bit Reactor confirmed their upcoming strategy title will offer a solid 30-40 hour main campaign that’s strictly linear, meaning no sprawling romances or branching paths to get lost in. Forget New Game+ or official mod support; this is a one-and-done Clone Wars tactical romp designed to be a refreshing palette cleanser after those monster RPGs. It sounds like the perfect game to pick up, beat, and feel accomplished without sacrificing your entire social life. Get ready for some concentrated Star Wars strategy fun this August 27th!

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave carries on the series's proudest tradition
take: Get ready for a fresh dose of Fire Emblem charm, because Fortune's Weave is doubling down on its most beloved character type: the himbo! We're talking about new additions Sirocco, a flirty bard who calls himself 'the Whimsical Wind' and loves "all women," and Tobias, a beefcake general who struggles with remembering names. These two join a proud legacy of lovable, if slightly dense, heroes like Sylvain from Three Houses and Gatrie from Path of Radiance. With a cast of 32-40 characters, and a plot revolving around the Heroic Games, you can bet there are even more charmingly air-headed warriors waiting to steal your heart when Fortune's Weave hits Nintendo Switch 2 on September 17th!

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past Reveal Date Confirmed
take: Get ready to dive back into the Continent! CD Projekt has finally confirmed that The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past, the long-awaited third expansion, will be revealed at gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live, with a full launch in 2027. It's wild to think we're getting new Geralt adventures 12 years after the original, but co-developing with Fool’s Theory (who know their Witcher stuff) means we’re in good hands. This isn't just a trip down memory lane, though; CD Projekt says Songs of the Past will set the stage for The Witcher 4, giving us a standalone Geralt story that also acts as a clever prologue. We're hyped to see what new mysteries Geralt's third sword will uncover!

title: Final Fantasy 14's attempt to take the MMO mobile is over before the world even gets the chance to see it
take: Big bummer for mobile MMO fans: Final Fantasy 14's mobile version is pulling the plug in China and, sadly, that means the global release is now a no-go too. This wasn't just a simple port; it was a unique, streamlined take on A Realm Reborn with some seriously cool quality-of-life upgrades and cosmetics that even regular FF14 players envied. While it's sad to see those awesome new hairstyles and inventory tweaks disappear with the mobile game, here's hoping Square Enix takes a hint and brings some of those brilliant features to the main game!

title: The modern Final Fantasy era began 25 years ago, with one fan-favorite game
take: Can you believe it's been 25 years since Final Fantasy 9 launched and gave us a heartfelt goodbye to the PS1 era? But it was Final Fantasy 10 that truly kicked off the modern age for the series, launching just one year later. With its revolutionary voice acting, deep character connections, and the epic journey of Tidus and Yuna, FF10 changed everything! Plus, Square finally ditched the ATB system for snappier combat and introduced the iconic Sphere Grid, letting us customize our heroes like never before. It's a game that still holds up and totally deserves a replay for its incredible story and innovative gameplay!

title: Jennifer English Steps Away From Tides of Annihilation Role Due to Health Concerns
take: Big news from Eclipse Glow Games! Jennifer English is stepping down from voicing Gwendolyn in Tides of Annihilation due to health reasons, which is a bummer, but totally understandable. The good news? The studio and Jennifer herself have already found a fantastic new voice actor to take over, someone who apparently blew them all away with their dedication and performance. You'll get to hear the fresh voice of Gwendolyn in the game’s demo at Gamescom this August – talk about a quick turnaround! It sounds like the team is handling this transition with grace and keeping the focus on delivering an epic narrative-driven action adventure.

title: Overwatch's attempt at bringing back 6v6 feels like a bad compromise—it just doesn't work
take: Overwatch’s latest Quickplay Hacked Event is trying to bridge the 5v5 and 6v6 gap, but it looks like a busted bridge to us! The new 1-3-2 flex mode, where one DPS can swap to tank, sounded like a clever way to keep 5v5's quick queues while adding some 6v6 chaos. However, it seems the developers underestimated the power of two tanks; teams with a duo tank setup absolutely steamrolled those with only one. This "compromise" just makes solo tanking feel weak and, honestly, a bit pointless. It’s a bold move by Team 4, but maybe some ideas are just better left on the drawing board.

title: PlayStation Summer Sale best deals: Resident Evil Requiem, Saros, and more
take: The PlayStation Summer Sale is here, and gamers, get ready to fill those backlogs without emptying your wallets! We're talking serious discounts on some absolute bangers, including this year's top-tier Resident Evil Requiem at 20% off and the surprisingly early-bird special for Saros Digital Deluxe. Plus, don't sleep on Nioh 3 for a steal, or finally dive into Bungie's Marathon, which is perfect for trying out their slick shooter. With plenty of 2026 hits and timeless classics on sale, it's the perfect time to grab those titles you've been eyeing!

title: Will Halo: Campaign Evolved's New Missions Continue The Series' Ambitious, Troubled Expanded Universe?
take: Hold onto your Warthog, because Halo: Campaign Evolved’s upcoming Operation METEORITE is shaping up to be more than just a nostalgic trip! These three new missions, starring Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson a year before the original game, are bringing in a heavyweight writer from the novels, Troy Denning. This means we're not just getting some classic Covenant blasting; expect a deep dive into the rich, intricate Halo expanded universe, potentially tying into lore from books and comics that fans adore. It’s exciting to see the games embracing the full breadth of this epic sci-fi saga!
